purpose: Trigger-behavior spec for deterministic lexical routing and manual behavior checks.

cases.prompt: does the quick start in this readme still work
cases.assert: Runs the check and reports steps that would fail as written.

cases.prompt: are the setup instructions stale after I copied this project into a new repo
cases.assert: Flags stale paths and clone steps left over from the old layout.

cases.prompt: check my readme setup steps before I publish this repo
cases.assert: Checks the setup steps against the files before publishing.

cases.prompt: will the install instructions in this repo break for a new user
cases.assert: Reports missing files, scripts, requirements and undocumented variables.

cases.prompt: does the python version in the readme match the code
cases.assert: Compares the promised Python version with the syntax the code uses.

cases.prompt: write a readme for my project
cases.assert: Does not trigger when the user wants a README written.
Does not trigger for running tests.
Does not trigger when the user wants the setup actually performed.

cases.prompt: fix the typo in the readme
cases.assert: Does not trigger for a simple edit.
Does not trigger for a plain summary.
